scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

steps.check: N8未除得到24，除8回3；用單位脈衝檢查頻譜各格同值；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.checkEn: At N 8, 24 divided by 8 returns 3; an impulse checks equal spectrum bins. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: FFTW提供DFT計算與規劃；本課先固定符號與正規化，再討論執行計畫。
knowledge.textEn: FFTW provides DFTs and planning; fix signs/normalization before choosing plans.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 畫輸入、正向頻譜、反向輸出及1/N步驟，註明複數實虛部與方向符號；24/48及還原3一致，報告含DFT符號、長度、stride與縮放。
knowledge.textEn: Draw the input, forward spectrum, inverse output, and 1/N scaling step. Label real and imaginary parts and transform signs. Verify 24/48 and recovered 3 with sign, length, stride and scaling documented.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 未正規化的正反DFT合成得到N×x；還原時需明確除N，而非假設函式庫自動除。
knowledge.textEn: Unnormalized forward/inverse DFTs compose to N×x; recovery explicitly divides by N.

stages.title: FFTW：架構、所有權與資料介面
stages.description: FFTW提供DFT計算與規劃；本課先固定符號與正規化，再討論執行計畫；畫輸入、正向頻譜、反向輸出及1/N步驟，註明複數實虛部與方向符號。
stages.descriptionEn: FFTW provides DFTs and planning; fix signs/normalization before choosing plans. Draw the input, forward spectrum, inverse output, and 1/N scaling step. Label real and imaginary parts and transform signs.
